_about: F59 unlock lesson AT THE CONSOLE, between shifts: the first time the console shows at rank 5 or more (upgrading unlocks at progression.json unlocks.upgrades). At the console the monitor is the lesson's surface: its one line goes on the monitor's screen and the Upgrades button gets the pink outline — no dim, no Got it (nothing is paused between shifts). Opening Upgrades finishes it (once per device; Settings → Replay lessons plays it again); leaving for a shift first, it comes back next time. Words: content/text/en.json → lessons.unlock-upgrades.
